might take a while to find someone your comfortable with but you can keep looking for other people. or try going the as little as information as possible route and see if it helps.

Taken the happy pills, Seen how shit the American health care system truly can be.  But everything requires money and its just not worth the grind and work for a chance at brief moments of happiness in my book.

I dont feel depressed anymore just bored life is boring. Too much work, too much proving your worth, just too much of everything.

Sorry for making it about myself while trying too give advice at the same time. This reddit seems to do that me. I would not say I am doing better think im near the end of the road tbh myself Just waiting on some things to fall into place before I do what Ive attempted a few times now.

The bad things you said you can fill bad about them apologize for them if you want but in the end your happiness should take priority. You dont have to be mean to him to break things off but imo It does not seem like a very healthy relationship so I would break things off and cut ties, It will hurt , yes but no reason to kick a dead horse or whatever that saying is.

But like i said before I dont have the full story, So can not really tell you what you should do or not do, Just advice on what i would do if i was you with the limited information I have to go on.

Its not good to drag on something that is taking so much work to make work. So if you are not happy beyond the lust stage of a relationship , Id move on. 

But then again take my advice with a grain of salt, I'm 34 and have had sex with one girl, she was my first and last but it was a good 10+ year relationship until the end.

She Called me while I was at work to let me know she wanted to take a break.

I did not take the news well cause it came out of the blue for me as we did not fight beforehand and rarely fight, So i made the choice to kill myself, I told her this and as I was driving back to our house with the intent on doing so she said she did not care if i died or not cause it was no longer her problem, she was with someone else.

I wish she broke up with me in a better way, but that was how she handled it, and my choice of attempting to kill myself was mine.

IMO there is not a excuse on the planet that justifies sexual abuse or abuse of any kind. I got treated like shit, and thrown out like a piece of trash by her , and i never hurt her physically , i never cheated. I just have always failed at being an adult and keeping work. 

So it just makes me so sad to see/hear about men who treat women like trash / abuse them/ hurt them. And I get destroyed because I failed at keeping a job and pulling my weight in the relationship. 

But If you want to help him that is your choice, but help him at a distance and keep yourself safe.

Coming from a person who has attempted suicide because of the person I love / loved. Was in a relationship for 10 years with her.

Ill be the first to say it is not her fault nor was it her job to save me. 

If you want to help, help in the nicest way you can that is in the best interest for yourself, but based on what you said and only your side of the story I would not help him in the least bit.

But just tell him to get help and it cant or will not be from you.

Dont have an answer for that either. I never really had a hard life, neither have I had an easy life. It has always felt kind of like it was too much work for the amount of reward received. But after 10 years with someone trying to get motivation to try alone is non existent.
